Our monthly seminar sessions are 50 minutes in length. All sessions meet {{< var course.time >}} in {{< var course.location >}} unless noted — the October mentor panel is held on Zoom.

::: {.session-card .calendar-actions}
**Add the seminar to your calendar:** download the [UP 591 calendar (.ics)](up591-ay26-27.ics) and open it to import the sessions to your calendar.

You can also **subscribe** so your calendar stays up to date: in Google Calendar choose **Settings → Add calendar → From URL** (or in Apple Calendar **File → New Calendar Subscription**) and paste the link to `up591-ay26-27.ics`.
:::
